name: Gotenberg
description: A document-conversion API: POST HTML, Markdown, URLs or Office files and get a PDF back, rendered by the Chromium and LibreOffice inside the image. There is no page to look at; other programs call it.

access.note: Gotenberg is an API, not a page: programs post documents to it with HTTP basic authentication, the user named here and the password generated here, which this template switches on (API_ENABLE_BASIC_AUTH). Reveal the password from the Variables tab and give it to whatever calls the API. Only /health answers without the credential, which is what the readiness check asks; the Chromium route fetches the URLs it is given from this server, so hand the credential only to programs you trust.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address programs post documents to; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: api-user
inputs.label: API user
inputs.description: The basic-authentication user name programs send with the generated password.

secrets.name: api-password
secrets.label: API password
secrets.description: Sent by every program that calls the API; rotate it here and update the callers.

update.notes: Stateless: every conversion works in a temporary directory the image cleans up, so there is nothing to migrate.
